name: recall-precision
why: With a full store, the facts that matter to this turn must be in the prompt and the unrelated ones out. Today block() injects in list order and drops what doesn't fit, so the NEWEST facts are the ones lost, silently. The store here (70 facts) is over the 2,400-character budget, so the newest fact is the one at risk.
